verses.1: The event that happened to Jerimiah, and to all the Jews during the fifth year of Jehoiakim, son of Josiah, king of Judah, was the first year of Nebukadnezar, king of Babylon.
verses.2: As the prophet Jeremiah said to all the people of Judah, and to all those who lived in Jerusalem:
verses.3: From thirteen years after Josiah, son of Amun, king of Judah, until today, these are thirty-two years. These thirty-two years have been a time when the words of Jehovah were spoken to me. But you have not listened to them.
verses.4: And Jehovah will send to you all His servants who are ascending. But they will not be heard to, nor will they be listened to by you.
verses.5: Let them say, “Come back again from your evil paths! Depart from those who are harmful to you. Return to the land that Jehovah has given you and your ancestors for ever and ever.”
verses.6: And do not follow other gods to worship them and to bow down before them. Do not provoke me in whatever you do. And may it not happen to you.
verses.7: And do not listen to me, O LORD! For your actions are evil to you.
verses.8: Therefore, thus said Jehovah, the God of hosts: “Because you have not listened to my words.”
verses.9: I am sending them, and I will take away all the tribes of Sodom. May the LORD do so! And let Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, and his servants come and destroy this land, its inhabitants, and all the nations around here. They will be destroyed forever.
verses.10: And I was freed from their voices of sorrow and joy, from the voices of bridegrooms and brides, from the voices of sighs and the sound of wind.
verses.11: And all this land would become a ruin and desolation. These nations would serve King Babylon for seventy years.
verses.12: And it shall be that in the seventy years, Babylon’s king and that nation will be destroyed. The LORD will destroy them, along with their land, which will become a desolate place. I have appointed them to be destroyed forever.
verses.13: And I have brought upon that land all those things that I said about it. All the words written in this book were fulfilled when Jeremiah wrote about all those nations.
verses.14: For they served many nations and great kings. I fulfilled their demands and desires, just as they wished.
verses.15: For as Jehovah God said, “Take this warm basket from my hands.” Then he placed it in front of all the nations whom I will send to them.
verses.16: And they became drunk, and they sinned. They cried out in grief because of the destruction that I had sent among them.
verses.17: And I will take the basket from the hands of Yahweh, and I will pour out all the nations whom Yahweh has sent to them.
verses.18: I will destroy Jerusalem and all the cities of Judah, as well as their kings and rulers. I will make them a ruinous place, a source of shame and disgrace, just as it is today.
verses.19: Ephraim, the king of Egypt, and his servants, his priests, and all his people.
verses.20: And all the kings of the land of Egypt, and all the kings of the land of Assyria, and Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and all the rest of the towns in Ashdod.
verses.21: Edom, Moab, and the children of Ammon.
verses.22: And all the kings of Syria, and all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the islands beyond the sea.
verses.23: And Dedan, and Tema, and Boz, and all the inhabitants of Peah.
verses.24: And all the kings of Arav and all the kings who live in the Midbar.
verses.25: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Eilam, and all the kings of Madai.
verses.26: And all the kings of the nations, both those who lived near and far away from each other, and all the queens of the earth who ruled over them. And King Shekhak will be their successor.
verses.27: And you said to them, “Thus says the LORD, the God of Israel: ‘Be quiet and submit! But if you do not obey, then I will send destruction among you.’”
verses.28: And it shall be that when we come to take the cup from your hands to drink from it, and you say to them, “Thus says the LORD, the God of hosts: Drink from it!”
verses.29: For behold, in the city whose name I bear, I am about to do evil. And you also will be destroyed; do not be saved, for I am about to destroy all those who live in this city. May the LORD, the Almighty, say so.
verses.30: And you will declare to them all these things. You will say to them, “The LORD has spoken from His holy place. His voice will cry out over the land, and He will answer every one of those who dwell on earth.”
verses.31: Sharon spread his influence throughout the land, because God had decided to judge those who were evil in all nations. They were given over to destruction, according to the word of Jehovah.
verses.32: Thus said Jehovah, the God of hosts: “Look! Trouble is coming from one country to another. A great storm will be caused by those who rule over the earth.”
verses.33: And they shall be a desolation for the LORD on that day. From one end of the land to the other, they will not be gathered or collected together. They will not be buried in graves on the surface of the earth.
verses.34: The wicked cried out in pain and wailed. The rulers of the land fell down, as if their days were filled with suffering and sorrow. They fell like dead bodies.
verses.35: And Manos died among the enemies, while Pelaya was saved from the great rulers of the land.
verses.36: The cries of the wicked and the wails of the great ones of the sheep were heard, because Jehovah has saved them from their ruin.
verses.37: And let us rejoice in the peace that comes from Jehovah’s grace.
verses.38: Kafir left his land, because it was in danger from the forces of heaven and from those who were against him.
